employment.left.note: Dates and title match. The letter is short — two lines — and says nothing about his conduct.

c05_polished.text: An exceptionally polished resume: MBA, executive assistant certification, six years supporting a managing partner.

c05_access.text: Handled his former Managing Partner's confidential correspondence and deal calendar.

c05_ceo_statement.text: Personal statement is aimed squarely at working for "your CEO".

c05_interview.text: HR phone screen: "outstanding communicator" — but he asked unusually detailed questions about the CEO's travel and board calendar.

c05_letter_brief.text: Experience letter confirms dates and title only. No comment on performance or conduct.

c05_halden_dates.text: Halden & Rao HR confirms his dates and title.

c05_halden_warning.text: Halden & Rao HR, off the record: NOT eligible for rehire. Two clients' deal terms leaked to a competitor; access logs pointed to his account. He resigned before the inquiry concluded.

c05_leak_news.text: News: Halden & Rao lost a ₹40-crore mandate in 2025 after a client's confidential terms surfaced at Vantor Capital.

c05_dsouza_vantor.text: His reference, Diana D'Souza, now works at Vantor Capital — the competitor that received the leaked terms.

c05_dsouza_praise.text: Diana D'Souza: "Karan is discreet, brilliant, indispensable."

c05_dsouza_evasive.text: Asked where she works now, Diana D'Souza deflects and ends the call.

c05_late_email.text: At 01:42 he emailed recruitment asking for the CEO's weekly schedule "to prepare in advance".

c05_review.text: An anonymous review calls him "arrogant". Unverifiable and not job-relevant.

search.title: Halden & Rao loses ₹40-crore mandate after deal terms surface at rival
search.snippet: Confidential terms of a pending acquisition appeared in a Vantor Capital counter-offer...
search.body: NEW DELHI, July 2025. Advisory firm Halden & Rao has lost a ₹40-crore mandate after confidential terms of a pending acquisition appeared, almost verbatim, in a counter-offer from Vantor Capital. Halden & Rao said an internal review was 'ongoing'. One staff member resigned during the review.

search.title: Diana D'Souza — VP Strategy, Vantor Capital
search.body: Diana D'Souza. Vice President, Strategy — Vantor Capital (August 2025–present). Previously Associate Director, Halden & Rao Advisory (2017–2025).

search.title: "Arrogant, but gets things done" — anonymous
search.body: Anonymous review, unverified: 'Arrogant. Treats juniors like furniture. Gets things done though.' The site does not verify reviewers' identities.
